name: bicrement
description: Evidence-oriented product and software engineering workflows for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-oriented product and software engineering skills
interface.longDescription: Reusable workflows for product, software, service, and operational work.
defaultPrompt: Use $bicrement:goal-pursuit to pursue one non-trivial goal through proportional system planning, adaptive evidence, and the smallest sufficient available capabilities.
Use $bicrement:research-synthesis to determine what bounded cross-source evidence supports.
Use $bicrement:architecture-surface-mapping to orient me to this unfamiliar software.
Use $bicrement:software-change-orchestration when this bounded change needs continuity across sessions, artifacts, or specialist owners.
Use $bicrement:code-review to review this completed software change.
